text:
Ethan: quick catch from billing - customers saw token spikes during a canary last night where fallback copies were counted twice. do we have a policy?
Priya: ugh. fallback semantics are fuzzy today. router marks final responder as "served" which can inflate counts if fallback stitches on top of primary request.
Lena: separate question: how do we surface this in the console? ops want to know when a rollout is consuming the grace budget.
Marco: proposal: add a per-rollout 'charge_policy' enum on the rollout API: full | grace | none. default = full.
Ethan: explain 'grace' -- first M tokens in window are not billed? who controls M?
Marco: yes, grace = free up to N tokens per window (e.g., 10k tokens / 24h). operator sets N when creating rollout. used for canaries only.
Priya: defensibility: need rate limits and hysteresis so customers can't flip rollouts repeatedly to avoid charges. also expose a cooldown in UI.
Lena: UI idea: replace the rollout % badge with a compact line: "Degrade 2.3%  ·  Grace left: 3.4k" and make the number clickable to show history.
Ethan: audit requirement: any operator-chosen grace changes must create an immutable audit event with justification, actor, and before/after. security will want schema.
Priya: agree. audit events should NOT include model outputs or request bodies. only metadata: rollout_id, charge_policy, tokens_granted, actor, reason_code, ts. sample schema: 
```
{
  "event_type": "rollout_grace_updated",
  "rollout_id": "r-12345",
  "actor": "alice@redwood.com",
  "reason_code": "canary_adjust",
  "tokens_granted": 10000,
  "ts": 1620000000
}
```
Marco: telemetry sampling: we need adaptive sampling tied to fallback_rate(route). suggestion: baseline low sampling (0.1%) -> if fallback_rate > 1% bump to 10% for 15m, then decay back with factor 0.5 every window.
Lena: can we make sampling per-route+org so SRE canfocus on problematic customers?
Ethan: yes but costs. need Finance signoff. add an estimated monthly delta in the PR.
Priya: router changes: emit decision tag on request meta: decision={primary|fallback|quarantine}, reason={timeout|oom|rate_limit|model_error}. small payload, feature-flagged. example: 
```
{
  "decision": "fallback",
  "reason": "timeout",
  "policy": "auto-fallback-v3"
}
```
Marco: backend should write the decision to both metrics (counter, gauge) and to sampled traces. traces should scrub outputs and PII. default traces off.
Lena: operator override button on rollout page: Pause fallbacks / Resume. on Pause require a short justification modal. create an audit entry and optionally alert on-call.
Ethan: access control: only roles in group "rollout-operators" can pause; escalation requires multi-approval if outside business hours.
Priya: implementation sketch for sampling popup: 
```
if fallback_count(route, 60s) > 10:
  set_sampler(route, 0.1)  # 10% for traces
  set_cooldown(route, 900)
```
Marco: also add a small "grace budget" widget to invoices export so Finance can reconcile free tokens per rollout.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: created ticket PLAT-4823 "rollout grace_budget + decision_trace + sampling config" and scheduled staging deploy.
Lena: next steps: Marco to add API field + migration notes; Priya to draft audit/schema; Ethan to coordinate Finance estimate; I'll mock the UI and post Figma. sync Monday 9am.
Ethan: cool. any blockers?
Priya: dependency on billing export changes - will take a week.
Marco: will feature-flag the rollout API changes.
Lena: thanks team, will post mocks shortly :mag:
